notes.title: We are incredibly proud to announce: OFFICIAL RELEASE HAS HAPPENED!
notes.notes:
We are incredibly proud to announce: OFFICIAL RELEASE HAS HAPPENED!

Our hardcore platformer Gold for Retirement is already waiting to break your nerves into splinters!

Forget about a quiet old age!

Here you will find:

➜ Deadly saws and spikes that love unexpected encounters.

➜ Dozens of sophisticated levels

➜ Tough but fair gameplay in the spirit of legendary platformers.

➜ Stylish pixel graphics and a bombastic soundtrack.

Will you be able to collect enough gold to finally relax? Or will retirement remain an unrealistic dream?

🔥 PLAY NOW AND CHECK YOURSELF! 🔥
